EGG-ONOMICS / ORIGINAL COMPLETE DATA

Three-month forecasts for all nine models.

Validation selects Holt-Winters. Lowest observed test RMSE belongs to Damped Holt. Validation: Nov 2024 to Jan 2025; test: Feb 2025 to Apr 2025. Each forecast is issued once from its origin and is not updated within the three-month window.

The input is the original complete BLS/FRED egg-price snapshot, January 1980-April 2025: 544 monthly observations with no missing prices or months. All models use observed data without filling or interpolation. Forecasts are historical, starting after April 2025.

Training STL seasonal strength: 0.225. All ACF lags are months.

Only three observations are scored in each evaluation period. The test includes the early-2025 price shock, so errors and interval coverage can be poor. These dates differ from the earlier annual evaluations; comparisons do not isolate horizon alone. Treat results as an exploratory historical investigation.

Forecasting settings and transformations match the earlier analyses. Automatic ETS and ARIMA structures are selected using each fitting window only. ARIMA searches use AICc, exact maximum likelihood and stepwise search. Three-month forecast horizon does not change the monthly seasonal period of 12.

Reproduce with analysis/forecast.R. Predictions, means, intervals, parameters, data-quality checks and fitted objects are saved in results.
